name: RL Hudson
old_description: RL Hudson is a trusted U.S. manufacturer specializing in custom plastic injection molding, rubber components and value-added unit assembly.
about:
RL Hudson was established in 1980 in Tulsa, Oklahoma, initially distributing rubber O-rings to the region's oil industry. The company relocated to Broken Arrow in 2004 and remains under the leadership of the Hudson family, with Rick Hudson as chairman, Jason Hudson as CEO, and Blake Hudson heading sales and marketing.

The company operates as a full-service molder and assembler, running plastic injection presses from 85 to 4,000 tons with scientific (decoupled) molding monitored by AuthenTIG systems. It also produces custom rubber parts via injection, transfer, and compression molding, plus wrapped and extruded formed hoses. In-house tooling design, machining, and maintenance support both molding lines, while plastic welding (ultrasonic, spin, hot-plate, vibration), pad printing, and a high-volume automated assembly line round out the operation.

RL Hudson serves OEMs across automotive, HVAC, medium and heavy trucks, outdoor power equipment, powersports, agriculture, appliances, marine, power generation, waterworks, heavy equipment, material handling, and on-highway engine sectors. Customers rely on the firm for part consolidation, metal-to-plastic conversions, and end-to-end assembly of multi-component units.

The company emphasizes its integrated "under one roof" model—combining molding, rubber, welding, tooling, and assembly—to deliver tighter quality control, faster turnaround, and cost-effective solutions. It holds ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and IATF 16949 certifications and promotes a zero-defect mentality backed by real-time process monitoring and error-proofing systems.
